_comment: Exercises wintty.c docorner() (3650-3712) against render_status() (4991-5262) with statuslines:3, terrainstatus and Deaf. Dropping wished gold narrows BL_GOLD by one column, so BL_HUNGER's column and the conditions move left and the old last letter stays ("Deaff"). The inventory, padded with wished objects to reach the last status row as a corner window, is repaired by docorner(), whose cl_end() erases the terminal row without touching cw->data; the BL_RESET pass that follows leaves "Deaf".
